# JiuwenSwarm Process SDK

Unmodified TypeScript compiler output from `sdks/typescript` at
[openJiuwen-ai/jiuwenswarm revision 8315c183a5d02fdab1674ab5120449c1d4b6728c](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/jiuwenswarm/tree/8315c183a5d02fdab1674ab5120449c1d4b6728c/sdks/typescript).
SDK version: 0.1.0. License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and file copyright headers.

Rebuild with `pnpm --filter @rakazo/runtime-jiuwenswarm build:sdk`. The script
fetches the exact revision, uses its npm lockfile with lifecycle scripts disabled,
and runs its TypeScript build. It does not require an npm SDK release. Only the
four compiled SDK files and license are copied. Do not edit the generated files.
